settings.title: Dictation
settings.summary: Shows the microphone button, so you can speak a message.
settings.description: Whether the composer has the microphone button for dictation. In Chrome and Edge the browser sends what you say to its maker's speech service, and Keystone receives only the words; off, the button is not drawn.

settings.title: Dictation language
settings.summary: The language dictation listens for; empty is your browser's.
settings.description: The language dictation listens for, as a language tag such as en-US or fr-FR. Empty uses the browser's own language.

settings.title: Show words as you speak
settings.summary: Shows the words dictation is still hearing, under the box.
settings.description: Whether dictation shows the words it is still hearing, under the box, before they are final and put in it.

settings.title: Listening time
settings.summary: The longest dictation listens at one go.
settings.description: The longest dictation listens at one go, such as 2m. It then stops and leaves what it heard in the box for you to review. 0s listens until you stop it or the browser does.

settings.title: Dictation finish wait
settings.summary: How long dictation waits for the last words after it is stopped.
settings.description: How long dictation waits for the browser's last words after it is stopped, before it stops waiting and keeps what it has.
